sections.text:
[Effects]
The following will activate if your Class is Soldier/Lancer:
Reduces Unison Attack and Great Spirit Unison Attack damage of all elements taken by M+.
The following will activate if your Class is Soldier/Lancer:
Lowers the effect of Cost reduction by M+.

[Activation Category]
Defense Awakening Constant Skill (up to 2 Constant Skills of the same category can be used at once).

[Activation]
Only activates when playing as Soldier/Lancer.

[Activation Rate]
Constant
